lines.text: @maya_front walks the length of the waterline at dawn as the light comes up gold behind her, then stops and looks out to sea.

new_beats.text: A small wave slides up the sand and erases her footprints.

writes.note: I added a moment at 3 s: a wave washes over her footprints. Your words are unchanged.

reply.rationale: Kept the action and direction as written and added one timed moment that deepens the quiet dawn mood without adding names.
